answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 14903 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: As salamaliakum brother, i would like to perform Hajj along with my mother. but i have Bank Loan. So could u tell me that is it Permissible to perform Hajj or not. Thanking You! Question: As salamaliakum brother, i would like to perform Hajj along with my mother. but i have Bank Loan. So could u tell me that is it Permissible to perform Hajj or not. Thanking You! Answer ID: 14903 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1447/1179=d/1430) It is better to pay off the debt first and then perform hajj. If the resources of repaying the debt are at hand and the hajj may not create any problem in repayment, so you can perform the hajj and the hajj will be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
